title: Gagánbadibá
direction: Follow broad rhythmic phrases rather than individual percussion. Use warm, rounded clusters and keep forces moderate. Because the track carries its own cultural/lyrical identity, avoid turning it into a flashy visualizer.

sections.name: rounded: opening
